outliers.description:
Discover the M3 Lee, one of America's most unusual tanks of World War II!

Unlike conventional tanks, the M3 Lee featured two main guns: a 75mm cannon mounted in the hull and a 37mm gun inside its rotating turret.

But why did American engineers create such an unusual design? What happened when it faced German forces in North Africa? And why was it eventually replaced by the legendary M4 Sherman?

Explore the fascinating history of American military engineering in this short WWII documentary.
